messages:
alex: Heads up — saw weird PP bubble growth on 16xA100 1F1B runs. Baseline 1F1B microbatch=8 had steady latency ~220ms/token but last night we saw periodic bubble spikes to ~420ms. Profiling attached (perf callgraph + nvprof). Anyone seen KV cache being the culprit?

maya: I think it's a mismatch between kernel selection and variable seq lengths — kernels get recompiled or fallback to less-opt path when microbatch pattern shifts. Also KV cache churn from cache misses can serialize all-reduce. Did you check per-step KV hit rate?

alex: Per-step stats: KV hit avg 0.92 but at spike it drops to 0.56 for ~12 steps. I dumped profiler w/ --prof-pp and --kv-trace. Grep snippet: ```step,kv_hit,allreduce_us
120,0.56,83
121,0.60,78
122,0.58,88```

sasha: If KV miss causes extra gather/scatter then comm overlaps vanish. Try staggered microbatching: randomize microbatch sizes across devices to smooth peak memory and avoid synchronized misses.

jordyn: Also try adaptive kernel selection per-microbatch: if sequence length distribution changes, pick kernels tolerant to misalignment (vectorized vs scalar kernels). We have a flag --kernel-mode=adaptive that picks slower but less variance kernels.

chris: Ran a quick sweep: implemented staggered microbatch (sizes [6,8,10,6] across PP stages) + --kernel-mode=adaptive. Results on perf bench (8 pp, tp2): median per-token latency 215ms (vs 223 baseline), 95p bubble reduced from 60ms -> 18ms, throughput +6.8%. Logs: ```PROF: bubble_p95=18ms, avg_kv_hit=0.90, allreduce_tail=12us```

maya: nice. Can we make it automatic? Idea: run short warmup with jittered microbatches and measure KV hit/AR tail, then pick stagger pattern per model.

kevin: wrote a quick patch to runtime scheduler: it samples seq-length histogram during warmup and emits microbatch map per PP stage. PR incoming. Will also expose runtime metric `pp.stagger_map` to console.

ci-bot: perf/pp-stagger scheduled tests triggered: https://ci.example.com/1234 — 4 configs

alex: thanks — can you add telemetry tag for `kv.bump_on_miss`? want to correlate with cache eviction events. Also record kernel fallback counts.

sasha: I'll prototype a small experiment that adapts microbatch pattern when KV hit<0.8 for >10 steps. If it oscillates we'll add hysteresis.

chris: FYI one gotcha: adaptive kernel increases single-step compute by ~3% — but lowers variance so better 95p. Need to ensure quantization kernels still supported.

jordyn: Agree. Let's run extended stability test overnight (8h) with adaptive + staggered vs baseline and collect p50/p95/p99 and allreduce tail distributions.

alex: cool. I'll stash profiler output in /mnt/prof/1847654321/ and link in the PR. Thanks all :trophy:
